query: What will be the primary activities of the NRF?
response:
The primary activities of the National Research Foundation (NRF) according to the document provided will be as follows:

1. Fund competitive, peer-reviewed grant proposals of all types and across all disciplines (a).
2. Seed, grow, and facilitate research at academic institutions, particularly at universities and colleges where research is currently in a nascent stage, through mentoring of such institutions (b).
3. Act as a liaison between researchers and relevant branches of government as well as industry (c).
